note: G46: how much of G34's 0.2648 is the re-split rather than the method? Same rules, same ranker, same filter; the only variable is which test triples are scored.

controls.name: C1_reproduces_published_headline
controls.must_fire_because: the unmodified protocol must return the published figure before any number from this harness is believed
controls.can_fail_because: an `all` arm that does not return 0.2648 / 0.3929
controls.null_must_contain: a differing figure: the literals are transcribed from G34/RESULT.md, not read from this run

observations.what_would_fail_it: an `all` arm that does not return the published 0.2648 / 0.3929, which would mean this harness is not the instrument that produced them

controls.name: C2_detector_matches_pairs_not_density
controls.must_fire_because: the same-pair detector must be matching entity PAIRS, not the density of a graph where any pair is likely
controls.can_fail_because: a randomised-pair control returning a rate near the measured 30%
controls.null_must_contain: a high rate, which is what a density artefact would produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: a randomised-pair control returning a rate comparable to the measured 30%, which would mean the detector matches any pair at all

controls.name: C3_partition_is_exhaustive_and_disjoint
controls.must_fire_because: the two parts must recombine into the whole, or queries were lost or double counted
controls.can_fail_because: parts that do not sum to the test set, or an empty part
controls.null_must_contain: an unequal sum, which a mis-scoped mask would produce

observations.what_would_fail_it: the parts not summing to the whole

falsifiers.name: F2_clean_subset_matches_the_headline
falsifiers.can_fail_because: filtered MRR on the no-same-pair part is within 0.01 of 0.2648
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both outcomes: the same arm on the same rules scores the `all` partition at exactly the published figure
falsifiers.refutes: the whole row: if the leakage-free part scores like the headline, the re-split contributed nothing and this is a labelling defect
falsifiers.fires_when: filtered MRR on the no-same-pair part is within 0.01 of 0.2648
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_same_pair_share_too_small_to_matter
falsifiers.can_fail_because: fewer than 10% of test triples have a same-pair train edge
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a small share, which the randomised control shows this detector does report when the pairs are not there
falsifiers.refutes: the causal story: a share too small could not carry the jump whatever the restricted MRR says
falsifiers.fires_when: fewer than 10% of test triples have a same-pair train edge
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: filtered MRR on the leakage-free part landing within 0.01 of the published 0.2648, which would mean the re-split contributed nothing measurable and the finding is labelling only
